decision: Keep R1 immutable and not admitted. R1 integrity and most structural design properties pass static review, but the exact frozen producer's sidecar fails the current validator and the source/export contract is ambiguous. Use a separately sealed R2; no actual export, extraction, diagnostic or grade was run by this reviewer.

findings.evidence: The pinned H390 predictor emits `campaign_fit_scope='full-valid-feature-only'`; its sidecar has no `campaign_export_scope` or `feature_only` field. For this mode it emits `evaluation_membership_sha256=null` and `campaign_evaluation_membership_sha256=null`; only fit-subset and evaluation-only modes compute those respective digests. R1 instead requires `campaign_export_scope='full-valid-feature-only'`, `feature_only=true`, and a non-null `evaluation_membership_sha256` derived from row_groups. The first missing field fails the exact required-field loop at collection_support.py:73-75; accepting aliases alone would still fail the membership check at :81-83.
findings.execution_effect: Do not admit or run R1 collection against the actual control export.
findings.required_fix: Create an isolated R2 adapter that validates the producer's actual full-valid contract (`campaign_fit_scope`, exact campaign split SHA, explicit complete row_groups permutation, and expected null mode-specific membership fields), computes/records its own row-order digest, and adds fixtures copied from the pinned H390 producer schema plus wrong-scope/order rejection cases. Do not rewrite or normalize the frozen producer sidecar.
findings.title: Collector rejects the actual frozen H390 full-valid sidecar

findings.evidence: R1 pins the working-tree `scripts/predict_run.py` at SHA-256 750b9e77…4b65. The frozen H390 source manifest pins its executed `scripts/predict_run.py` at 30647bb7…54dd0. The former emits the schema R1 expects; the latter is the checkpoint-lineage source and emits the incompatible metadata above. The arrival command does not bind an exact producer command/source receipt contract, so these two possible exporters are not distinguished in the packet.
findings.required_fix: In R2, explicitly bind the selected export command, predictor source SHA/source manifest, checkpoint SHA and producer receipt schema. If using a compatibility-modified current predictor, identify and review that as the chosen export implementation rather than implying the frozen H390 producer schema.
findings.title: Preparation pins a different predictor than the frozen H390 source

findings.evidence: The helper parses the supplied expected-hash receipt as any JSON object, but does not check a required schema, success status, source/command identity, or that its prediction and sidecar bindings agree with the files. The output alignment receipt records only the receipt hash, byte count and optional schema field. A captured hash establishes byte integrity but not that this is a successful receipt for this exact export.
findings.required_fix: Add an exact receipt schema/status contract in R2 and cross-check its run, checkpoint, predictor source/command, prediction path/hash, sidecar path/hash, split and full-valid scope against the validated sidecar and prediction. Add small negative fixtures for failed/wrong-source/wrong-file receipts.
findings.title: Export receipt bytes are hash-pinned but their contract is not validated

findings.evidence: The collector resolves `args.output` before checking existence. A pre-existing dangling symlink can therefore resolve to a not-yet-existing target and cause the collector to create the target directory through that alias. The later `mkdir(exist_ok=False)` is race-safe for the resolved target, but does not reject the alias itself.
findings.required_fix: For complete create-only semantics, reject the caller-supplied output path with `lexists`/`is_symlink` before resolving it, and keep the exclusive mkdir. A root-owned exact clean-path check can also enforce this boundary.
findings.title: Output collision check follows path resolution

review_scope: Independent static review of artifact/source hashes, actual frozen H390 predictor sidecar contract, create-only outputs, derived diagnostic manifest, and no-training/no-checkpoint-load behavior. No export, model/checkpoint/prediction/target-array load, parquet payload read, remote call, or test rerun was performed.

verified_design_properties.create_only_writes: Existing ordinary output directories are rejected; directory creation uses exist_ok=False; NPY and JSON files use exclusive creation. The dangling-symlink alias is noted separately above.
verified_design_properties.derived_manifest: The helper copies the frozen diagnostic inputs, resolves their existing paths, adds the source-aligned strong_control NPY with paired-bundle/alignment receipt bindings, and appends only fixed comparisons against wide, fp32_mix and q8. The existing input validator checks those bindings. No blend search, calibration or tuning is introduced.
verified_design_properties.scientific_scope: One previously exposed F0 panel, 808863 rows and 141 components; the control is explicitly not the exact public incumbent. Grade helper conditions component bootstrap on fixed predictions and disclaims seed/public-transfer variation.
verified_design_properties.training_and_model_loads: Static imports and calls show no torch, model construction, checkpoint deserialization, optimizer, or training path. Runtime collection would memory-map the full prediction, load the compact scored bundle, and read only the pinned selected parquet groups/columns; this review did not execute those reads.
